'''Korrilan IV''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Zalpertine Cup/Legends|Zalpertine Cup]] was held on the world, a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] series that catered to [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|racers]] piloting [[CR-17 Incendia/Legends|CR-17 Incendias]].<ref name="EV" />
